name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the two requirements are captured exactly. 'Carry the box to the exit' is the endorsed carry-to pattern, hard Existence(at_exit) plus hard Response(at_exit, holding_box), which together force holding_box on the exit step (at_exit is last-step-only, so the Response closes on that same step). 'Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move' is hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), matching the 'very next move' timing. No clause is added, none is redundant, all propositions are declared and grounded, all are hard (no preference cue in the task), and the machine's final/rejecting behavior agrees: reaching the exit while holding the box is final, reaching it without the box fails, and a fall not followed by holding_box on the next step is rejected.

texts: Reach the exit carrying the box.
If the agent is at the exit, it is holding the box.
Every time the box falls, it is held on the very next step.
